capabilities.name: Get SKYFALL status
capabilities.description: Returns the local SKYFALL application and capability status. It does not inspect user files or connect to cloud services.
limitations: Reports local application capability state only.
Does not authenticate to Azure or Power Platform.
Does not inspect or execute local scripts.

capabilities.name: List SKYFALL capabilities
capabilities.description: Lists capabilities explicitly registered and enabled in the SKYFALL capability catalogue.
limitations: Planned integrations are not represented as executable tools.

capabilities.name: Describe a SKYFALL capability
capabilities.description: Returns the registered description, inputs, risk level and limitations for one SKYFALL capability ID.

capability_id.description: Exact capability ID, for example core.get_status.

limitations: Only returns entries from the local capability catalogue.
Does not activate or install capabilities.

capabilities.name: Get workspace index status
capabilities.description: Returns aggregate index status only for enabled workspaces whose metadata sharing was explicitly approved in the SKYFALL desktop UI.
limitations: Does not inspect folders or trigger a scan.

capabilities.name: List AI-approved workspaces
capabilities.description: Lists only enabled workspace roots for which the user explicitly allowed filenames and extracted metadata to be shared with Copilot.
limitations: Workspaces without AI metadata consent are omitted.
Does not return source code or secrets.

capabilities.name: Search workspace files
capabilities.description: Searches indexed filenames and locally extracted static metadata in enabled workspaces with explicit AI metadata-sharing consent.

query.description: Search words or script name, 1 to 200 characters.

file_type.description: all, scripts, documents, powershell, python, yaml, json, or markdown.

limitations: Source file contents are not returned.
Sensitive-looking files and detected secret-bearing files are excluded.

capabilities.name: Describe an indexed workspace file
capabilities.description: Returns extracted static metadata for one indexed file in an AI-approved workspace, including parameters, functions, imports and summary where detected.
limitations: Returns metadata only, not source code.
Only works for enabled workspaces with explicit AI metadata consent.
Static analysis is best-effort and does not execute code.
